BEFORE answering any "how do I..." question about 360Dialog products or processe

created a 360Dialog account yet.

tools.description:
Find a channel by passing in an identifier.

tools.description:

Update the WhatsApp profile for this channel (a.k.a. phone number.)

tools.description:

WhatsApp/Meta anything, so a number already active on WhatsApp elsewhere (including the personal
app

tools.description:
Get the link that lets the user connect a WhatsApp phone number in 360Dialog, plus what to tell them beforehand.

This hands over 360Dialog's own onboarding page. The user clicks
through Embedded Signup themselves; this tool cannot do it for them.

The user must be signed in to 360Dialog Hub already

tools.name: start_payment_setup
tools.description:
Get the link that lets the user add their credit card to their account.

country on file, the payment page is kept behind a company details form instead. In that case this
tool does not return the payment li

tools.description:
Get a phone number's status on whether a number is live, what type of messages it can send today,
and suggestions for what's next.

A live number can send free-form replies inside the 24-hour customer service window immediately
(meaning if someone messages the number, the user can respond to the mes

tools.name: request_otp
tools.description:
Request an OTP code.

Sometimes OTP is needed to complete invoking a tool. When tool invocation fails due to OTP reasons, you will be
notified in the tool response, and be asked to rqeuest an OTP code.

Only call after a tool call fails due to OTP.

tools.name: verify_otp
tools.description: Verify the 6-digit OTP code from the user. Doing so will automatically replay the blocked tool call that required verification.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List templates for a WABA (WhatsApp Business Account). If you do not have a waba_account_id ending in 'WA' (case-insensitive), run the 'list_channels' tool first.

tools.name: show_template_preview
tools.description: Show a preview of a given template to the user.

{
  "name": string,
  "language": string,
  "category": "MARKETING" | "AUTHENTICATION" | "UTILITY",
  "components": Component[],
}

General rules:
- name must be lowercas

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a WhatsApp message template by its internal template ID.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description:
Get a channel's (a.k.a. phone number's) webhook URL, and check if the optional webhook headers are set.

the user may see 32 requests being made to their webhook server.

Returns the test's results, showing which cases

tools.name: get_self
tools.description:
Get currently logged in user's information in 360Dialog. You will get:
- user's name,
- user's email address,
- partner name,
- user's permissions in 360Dialog Hub,
- user's roles

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users for the selected account, including their roles and creation timestamps.

tools.name: sandbox_register_number
tools.description:
Register the user's phone number on the 360Dialog sandbox. Upon registration, the user can send messages to this phone number from the 360Dialog sandbox account on WhatsApp.

The user will be given a link to complete registration. When this link is used, they will send a verification code to 360Dial

tools.name: sandbox_complete_registration
tools.description: Complete a phone number's registration. This will get you the API key to use when sending messages from the 360Dialog sandbox phone number to the user's registered phone number.

tools.name: sandbox_send_message
tools.description:
Send a message on the 360Dialog sandbox. Messages can only be sent to the user's phone number that was used during sandbox registration.

The payload must be a JSON string matching the WhatsApp messages endpoint body.

Interactive message example: use this only when there is an active conversation w

tools.name: sandbox_configure_webhook
tools.description: Set webhook for the channel on 360Dialog sandbox. Optional.

tools.name: sandbox_get_webhook_configuration
tools.description: Get configured webhook for the channel on 360Dialog sandbox.

tools.name: sandbox_list_events
tools.description:
List webhook events received. This will show received messages from the user, and status of messages
sent from the sandbox account.

tools.name: getchat_send_message
tools.description:
Send a message into an existing conversation, as the business.

This is inbox-scoped sending: it posts into an existing conversation with
correct threading. Outside the 24-hour customer-care window, WhatsApp only
permits template messages — other types are rejected with an explanation.

tools.name: getchat_assign_conversation
tools.description:
Assign or reassign one conversation to an agent and/or a group.

Both fields are always set to exactly what you pass: calling with only
`user_id` clears any group assignment and vice versa; calling with neither
unassigns the conversation entirely.

tools.name: getchat_tag_conversation
tools.description: Add or remove one tag on one conversation.

tools.name: getchat_mark_conversation_as_read
tools.description:
Mark one conversation's messages as read by the calling user.

Pass `up_to_timestamp` after reviewing a conversation so that messages
arriving in the meantime stay unread. The read mark only moves forward: a
timestamp older than the caller's current mark changes nothing. Read state
is per inbox user

tools.name: getchat_apply_saved_response
tools.description:
Send a saved (canned) response into a conversation as a text message.

Subject to the same 24-hour window rule as getchat_send_message.

tools.name: getchat_list_conversations
tools.description:
List conversations of the inbox, newest activity first.

Returns one entry per conversation with contact info, unread count, last
message, current assignee (user and/or group), and tags.

tools.name: getchat_search_conversations
tools.description:
Find conversations by contact name, phone number, tag name, or message content.

Searches contact profiles and tags first, then message text and media
captions; results from both are merged and deduplicated by conversation.
Each match notes why it matched (`contact` or `message_content`).

tools.name: getchat_get_conversation
tools.description:
Read one conversation: contact/assignment/tag details plus its message history.

Messages are returned newest first. To page further back, call again with
`before_time` set to the oldest returned message's timestamp.

tools.name: getchat_list_inboxes
tools.description:
List the WhatsApp inboxes the calling 360dialog user can access.

Call this first when you don't know which `channel_id` to pass to the
other tools: each entry pairs a `channel_id` with its inbox URL and
WhatsApp number (`wa_id`). Entries without a `channel_id` cannot be
driven through these tools.

tools.name: getchat_list_agents
tools.description: List the inbox's agents (users) — for assignment via getchat_assign_conversation.

tools.name: getchat_list_groups
tools.description: List the inbox's agent groups — for group assignment via getchat_assign_conversation.

tools.name: getchat_list_tags
tools.description: List the inbox's tags — for tagging via getchat_tag_conversation and filtering via getchat_list_conversations.

tools.name: getchat_list_saved_responses
tools.description: List the inbox's saved (canned) responses — for use with getchat_apply_saved_response.

tools.name: mba_update_faq

tools.name: mba_delete_faq
tools.description: Delete one FAQ entry by its id. Returns no content on success.

tools.name: mba_list_websites
tools.description: List the websites the agent crawls for knowledge, with their crawl status. Known limitation: this returns a BARE ARRAY, not an object with a `data` key.

tools.name: mba_create_website
tools.description: Add a website URL for the agent to crawl into its knowledge base. Returns the entry with its id and crawl status. Crawling is asynchronous - the knowledge is not available immediately; poll mba_get_website for crawl_status.

tools.description: Read one website crawl entry by its id, including crawl_status, pages_crawled and last_crawled_at. This is how you check whether a site added with mba_create_website has been ingested yet.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_skills" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.detail: Description of "mba_get_connector" references sensitive artifacts (private key, credentials, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read one connector by its id, including its connection_status and mTLS metadata. Credentials are never returned - the private key and secrets stay at Meta.
